scope: exploratory-scientific within-cohort and budget-response analysis; no L4 promotion

method.unit: one matched seed; candidate fits and benchmark rows are not independent repeats
method.score: best exported validation outcome per run/benchmark; required contender floor independently selected per seed/budget
method.effect: direction-aware symmetric relative difference; positive favors engine or budget 128
method.interval: 4096 paired-seed percentile bootstrap resamples, RNG 0; only three seed units, limited uncertainty resolution
method.registration: post-run descriptive analysis using existing policy default; no preregistered engine-vs-floor hypothesis
method.multiple_testing: no significance claims; signed-rank and Friedman unavailable at this sample size
method.held_out_test: not evaluated; validation outcomes selected during search
method.runtime: whole exported run wall time, with per-fit training sum reported separately; fixed serial engine order confounds cold-cache/host effects
